title: Climate Change in Ecological Restoration
description: Examines how climate change shapes ecological restoration through a blend of Western science and Indigenous knowledge. Access and interpret climate data, assess vulnerability and risk, and apply adaptive responses culminating in practical tools like the Resist-Accept-Direct (RAD) framework to guide action in a changing world.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ER 339, ER 338A (if taken in the same topic).

items.text: Admission to Certificate or Diploma program in Restoration of Natural Systems
